findings.detail: C04 applies a stock-share completeness threshold to L.P. interests, for which the source appropriately reports no shares.

rationale: The March 31, 2026 schedule supplies shares for both actual stock positions: 28 for Eclipse preferred stock and 764 for Red Griffin common stock. The two Firebird rows are explicitly L.P. interests and the Principal / Shares cells are blank, which is appropriate for partnership interests and is not an extraction defect. On the visible source equity disposition, stock-share coverage is 2 of 4 positions (0.5), not the oracle's 2 of 5 (0.4), and the only missing-share rows are non-stock L.P. interests. C04 therefore fires because its denominator/scope treats all equity-classified positions as requiring shares.
